verdict.rationale: Nothing in the first-party evidence (Habana docs, Intel product pages) states tensor or matrix TFLOPS/TOPS with precision or sparsity. The only figures are community-quoted vector numbers (14 TFLOPS FP32, 28 TFLOPS FP16), which say nothing about matrix-engine throughput or sparsity. A commenter also complains that Intel gives no useful matrix-multiply throughput detail. The axis clearly applies to an AI accelerator, but the pack does not show it delivered.
